about_the_game:
Outta Gas? Outer Gas! In this unconventional gas station simulator, you take control over your very own space gas station and attend to your intergalactic customers’ needs: fill up their tanks, provide them with some snacks and send them back on their cosmic journeys!

Nail the perfect fuel fill-up to earn extra tips and keep your alien customers smiling (or oozing, or buzzing—depending on their biology).

Galactic exploitation is your cup of tea? Then get excited to set up and protect your own mining rigs on the nearest planet! Space pirates and alien creatures won’t make it easy to expand your gas station empire—stay alert and be ready to defend what’s yours.

  • Serve a variety of customers by pumping gas into their vehicles—just make sure to get the amount and fuel type right to maximize profit.

  • Upgrade your station with extra pumps and handy gadgets that make your job easier and keep the chaos under control.

  • Expand your operation by setting up mining rigs to extract the fuel yourself and keep the supply flowing.

  • Defend your business against space pirates and alien creatures who aren’t too happy about your growing empire.

Outer Gas is currently in early development stage and its progress will be updated regularly with new screenshots and gameplay footage.
